title: LTE RRC: Use array_length and fix a minor bug.
description:
If the index exceeded the array length, the comment said it would return the
last element of the array, but it would actually return the _index of_ the last
element of the array, which would be ambiguous at best and probably would not
serve any useful purpose.

It will now return the value of the last element of the array.
